r1Disposition: R1 closed with NO_ALPHA_JUDGMENT after partial outcome transport hit the connector tool-call ceiling. R1 symbols are not reused.

methodAuthority.primary: Pengfei Luo (2025), Chapter 3, Eq. 71 / Table 23 / Table 35
methodAuthority.basisSplit: ascending log basis into equal Low/High halves; if odd, deterministic median observation is dropped
methodAuthority.quintileOrientation: Q1 is the LOWEST characteristic quintile and Q5 is the HIGHEST characteristic quintile
methodAuthority.pca: covariance PCA of 32 development FPRV return series; first 3 PCs
methodAuthority.pcSignRule: orient each eigenvector so its sum of loadings is non-negative; if numerically zero, largest-absolute loading is positive
methodAuthority.composite: variance-explained-weighted average of the 3 oriented raw PC portfolio-return series

dataAuthority.perpetual: monthly klines; quoteAssetVolume and takerBuyQuoteAssetVolume used
dataAuthority.priceVolume: quoteAssetVolume, equivalent to aggregate price-times-volume for the 8h bar
dataAuthority.executionReturn: next 8h open to following 8h open after the completed decision bar

cohort.selectionRule: new current-active Binance Spot USDT + USD-M PERPETUAL symbols absent from the V18 outcome-exposure union for identical/closely-related FPRV research; stable and commodity-backed contracts excluded

costs.chargedOn: absolute composite portfolio weight changes plus terminal liquidation

failureRule: Any development gate failure closes R2 without threshold rescue. Fresh validation and sealed holdout remain sealed. Passing development authorizes only freezing the development PCA transform and opening fresh validation; it does not authorize production or R15 mutation.
